name: Serve
summary: Share a folder over local Wi-Fi
description: Pick a folder and serve its files over HTTP to a browser on the same network. Stop the server when you are done sharing.
author: thooton

changes.text: Common: setup files written whole from any thread, leftover setup files cleaned up, and every app on common bumped.
Build and publish immutable Wave package releases alongside the legacy channel.
Turn Android backup on in every app, so adb backup can move their data to another phone.
Down on the folder picker's last row now stays put instead of jumping to Cancel.
Switching folders while serving no longer stops with "port in use".
Round every app's launcher icon like Canvas and Books.
Draw the launcher icon in the app's teal.
Strip explanatory and instructional text from every app.
Drop app names and counters from the top of the light apps.
Finish the family restyle: menus, highlight, Mail's avatars.
